title: Minecraft Server Launch Checklist | Pre-Launch Setup Helper
description: Generate a launch checklist for Minecraft server owners covering security, performance, voting, DNS, backups, rules, and listing pages.
intro: Build a pre-launch checklist so you do not forget DNS, backups, permissions, voting, security, and listing basics before inviting players.
howTo: Select the type of server you are launching.
Choose whether you need crossplay and whether you self-host.
Copy the checklist and work through it before inviting public players.
Use the related guides for any item you do not understand yet.
faqs: Do I need everything before opening?
No, but backups, security, permissions, and basic performance checks should be done before public launch.
Should I list the server before launch?
You can prepare the listing early, then promote it when voting, Votifier, and join instructions are ready.
What matters most for first impressions?
Players need to understand how to join, what the server offers, and whether it feels active and stable.
